name: 'tell me more about X' files the facts as children under X, not as a narration node (M75)

seed.content: Google Nest WiFi Pro: simple setup, wired backhaul supported

rounds.user: tell me more about the google nest
rounds.assistant: Nest WiFi Pro: Wi-Fi 6E on the 6 GHz band (fast, shorter range); the 2-pack runs about $200–230; the app shows connected devices and a speed test but no per-device bandwidth; port forwarding is limited and there is no VLAN support.
